name: Raymarching with LOD-based Brick Caching
definition: A visualization method for Compressed Segmentation Volumes (CSVs) that uses raymarching to render volumes. It decompresses bricks on-demand at the required Level of Detail (LOD), stores them in a GPU cache, and exploits temporal coherency by allowing a one-frame lag for decompression requests.
summary: Raymarching with LOD-based Brick Caching renders massive segmentation volumes interactively by streaming compressed data on demand, using empty-space skipping and one-frame lag to exploit temporal coherency.
